findings.message: The release conformance document claims all requirements and acceptance criteria are matched, but the pinned verification evidence states that AC-001, AC-002, AC-003, and AC-004 visual support is not established, AC-002 lacks the required Playwright geometry run, and no release recommendation is supported. Reconcile the verdict table and summary with this evidence before release.
